surfaces.purpose: INTEG-1: append-only record of every terminal council proposal (approved or rejected)
surfaces.contains: proposal id, title, category, status, approval rate, vote counts, proposer

surfaces.purpose: V2-ALPHA: append-only record of every privileged perimeter call
surfaces.rotation: operator-managed (manual rotation; never carries credential material)
surfaces.contains: timestamp, source ip, route, response status, hashed session id (never the raw cookie)
